findings.title: Final sweep point is omitted from the endpoint rejection decision
findings.trigger: On the final positive sweep point scan_code==SPAN, average becomes a new minimum while the previous min_code is interior; nonblocking extrema writes have not updated the values used for qualification.
findings.expected: A minimum at +SPAN is rejected: RETRY_WAIT state=7, last_reason=1, servo_enable=0.
findings.actual: Monotonic ADC response reached LOCKING state=6, reason=0, min_code=1024, servo_enable=1.

log_excerpt: FINAL_SWEEP t=20555000 sample=952 old_scan_min=954 old_min_code=1022 old_contrast=2046
RESULT state=6 reason=0 min_code=1024 scan_min=952 scan_max=3000 selected_code=-2 setpoint=1978 servo_enable=1

replay.reset: rst=1 for five falling edges; then rst=0, arm=1
replay.inputs: dac_at_goal=1; adc_valid=arm; at every negedge adc_sample=3000-(dac_code+1024); servo_valid=0

findings.minimal_fix: Compute extrema and min_code including the current average before contrast/endpoint/half-level qualification, or add a sweep-finalization state.
